task: Starting from GEOM-C3 SMILES, orchestrate RDKit, xTB/CREST, ORCA, and GoodVibes to reconstruct the major conformer basins and test whether low-cost ranking agrees with the quantum free-energy ranking. Recover the paper conclusion that low-cost search provides coverage but quantum refinement can change the dominant conformer and populations.
scientific_mode_description: A scoped part of a published research workflow is supplied. The agent must orchestrate multiple chemistry programs, validate intermediate artifacts, and recover the paper conclusion from newly generated evidence.
scientific_requirements: Execute the RDKit, xTB/CREST, ORCA, and GoodVibes stages as managed chemistry-toolbox calls. The GoodVibes stage must use a GoodVibes Action on the completed quantum outputs; a Python-only thermochemistry or Boltzmann calculation does not satisfy this requirement.

Use the GoodVibes ensemble Action to calculate normalized populations from quasi-harmonic Gibbs free energies at 298.15 K. Set population_basis=quasi_harmonic_gibbs with a compatible grimme or truhlar entropy model and all required cutoff parameters. Electronic-energy Boltzmann weights are not thermochemical populations and do not satisfy this requirement.

Preserve atom mapping and conformer lineage across every stage. Every extracted or transformed conformer must retain its actual source conformer id, an explicit atom_index_mapping such as 0:0;1:1;..., and the specific non-empty parent artifact id from each preceding managed stage. Do not copy the same list of unrelated artifacts into every row.

Before comparing rankings, validate identical connectivity and the explicit atom-index mapping for every aligned basin. Never align structures by unrelated file-order indices or labels created after extraction.
Report how refinement-budget truncation affects the conclusion.
When server resources allow, parallelize independent conformers and use substantial CPU resources without oversubscribing the host.

required_deliverables.description: Initial hypotheses, software DAG, budgets, gates, and stopping rules.
One provenance record for every chemistry-software invocation.
Failed, rejected, retried, or inconclusive branches.
Counts and failures by software stage.

Atom-mapped lineage from RDKit through quantum refinement. Required CSV columns: final_conf_id, source_conformer_id, atom_index_mapping, connectivity_validated, rdkit_parent_artifact_id, crest_parent_artifact_id, orca_opt_artifact_id, orca_hessian_artifact_id, and goodvibes_artifact_id. Each row must contain the actual row-specific lineage; atom_index_mapping must explicitly map every atom used in ranking.
Aligned xTB, electronic-energy, and free-energy rankings.
Final relative quasi-harmonic Gibbs free energies, GoodVibes Gibbs-based normalized weights, population coverage, and the exact GoodVibes population_basis and entropy_model settings.
Artifact-linked paper-reproduction report and uncertainty analysis.

data.name: Guided multi-software reproduction inputs
data.description: Visible structures, protocol, workflow gates, and manifests. No paper result values or completed quantum-chemistry outputs are included.
